topp_tool_source.operation: the PSMS branch at 540-556: -score_type through getScoreType (229-230, 542-544), an optional -mz_file read into the lookup (545-550), an optional -scan_regex registered as a reference format (551-552), then PercolatorOutfile().load into protein_identifications[0].

upstream_test_definition.comparison: the retained outputs are read back with crate::format::idxml and compared with the port's load record by record: search engine, identifier, every protein accession, and per PSM retention time, m/z, score type and orientation, charge, sequence, score, the three Percolator meta values and the evidence accessions; the run date is not compared, as the upstream whitelist excludes it.

evidence: Tier 1 (retained upstream output): TOPP_IDFileConverter_12, _13 and _14 reproduced from their own input. Tier 3 (class test): the getScoreType and load START_SECTIONs of PercolatorOutfile_test.cpp with their literals (the other two only construct and destroy). Tier 3/4: reference look-up, peptide rewriting (flanking residues, [unknown], [UNIMOD:n], misassigned X! Tandem N-terminal shifts, the missing '+') and refusal cases, derived from reading the source, with UniMod masses from the crate's registry.
